research_items.fact: On the eve of the 1998 FIFA World Cup Final, Ronaldo Nazário suffered a convulsive fit at the team hotel. He was initially left off the starting lineup before being reinstated hours before kick-off. Brazil lost 3–0 to France.
In the 2002 FIFA World Cup, Ronaldo Nazário scored eight goals to win the Golden Boot and led Brazil to the championship, defeating Germany 2–0 in the final.
